# Hongdam หงส์ดำ — hongdam.net

> Hongdam หงส์ดำ ("the black swan") sells services from Chiang Rai, Thailand:
> errands and phone calls in Thai, translation and interpreting, outsourcing,
> websites and apps, servers and security, AI and bots, data, design and writing,
> retirement and care, moving, shipping, tours, weddings, luck and merit. In
> person in Chiang Rai and Chiang Mai; online anywhere.

## How the site is laid out

- https://hongdam.net/ — the front page: a search box over the cards, the
  popular cards, and a door to each category page.
- A category page per kind of work (listed below): cards, each with a name, a
  price, one line and one button.
- Five languages: English at /, Thai at /th/, Burmese at /my/, Chinese at /zh/, German at /de/
  (the same path after the prefix, e.g. https://hongdam.net/th/web/).
- Buy: https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=<card id> — pick the option, then pay by
  PromptPay QR, PayPal, Wise or bitcoin Lightning. An order's progress: https://hongdam.net/buy/?ref=<order number>.
- Anything not listed: https://hongdam.net/ask/, LINE @964yxgnk
  (https://line.me/R/ti/p/@964yxgnk), or nan@motdang.net.

## Machine-readable

- The cards with their prices, options and search words, one file per language:
  https://hongdam.net/assets/shop-en.json (and shop-th.json, shop-my.json, shop-zh.json, shop-de.json).
- Today's prices: https://hongdam.net/api/services — they move once a month with
  the orders taken (the walk is described under Services below).
- The sitemap, each page with its other languages: https://hongdam.net/sitemap.xml
- On each category page, schema.org JSON-LD: an OfferCatalog of Service entries
  with their Offers; on the front page, the Organization.

## Crypto safety: plan for worse

- [Crypto safety: plan for worse · Hongdam Studio](https://hongdam.net/studio/crypto-safety/): Binance lost about US$6.3 billion on 29 October 2026. Any exchange, phone or wallet can fail. A safety check, your own wallet, a plan for your family. From Chiang Rai, Thailand. The news of 2026-10-30 with sources, eight steps from a paused exchange to a family that cannot reach the coins, four questions, and the services: Safety check, 1 hour (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=crypto-safe); Your own wallet, set up with you (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=crypto-safe); Plan for your family (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=crypto-safe); After a loss: the paperwork (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=crypto-safe). The exchange board and calculator: https://offrampt.net/frozen/. Also: ไทย https://hongdam.net/th/studio/crypto-safety/ · မြန်မာ https://hongdam.net/my/studio/crypto-safety/ · 中文 https://hongdam.net/zh/studio/crypto-safety/ · Deutsch https://hongdam.net/de/studio/crypto-safety/

<!-- RETREAT:START -->
## Board retreat: five nights near Chiang Rai

- [Board retreat: five nights near Chiang Rai · Hongdam](https://hongdam.net/retreat/): Five nights in the hills near Chiang Rai for a board that wants to work as one: question-only mornings, then indigo, lanterns and forest food. A suite each. Days: Arrive: Van from Chiang Rai airport, Tok sen massage, White-thread welcome, khantoke dinner; Questions first: Intervision, Forage the forest with a Lahu guide, Cook what you found; One problem: Action learning, Dye indigo cloth, Longtail boat on the Mekong at sunset; Listen: Troika and Forum, Make a Lanna lantern, Dinner under your lanterns, a Lanna horoscope; Clearness: Sunrise balloon, or a walk in the tea hills, Clearness committee, Tea and hill coffee, cut a tung flag, Fire, stars, quiet; Agreements: Dawn alms, if you like, Write the agreements, sign them, Lunch, fly home. Prices for one board: ฿600,000 for nonprofits and foundations, ฿800,000 for companies; the pilot board pays ฿400,000 or ฿600,000. Rooms and meals are billed by the resort, about ฿38,000 a person for five nights. No retreats in the smoke season (March to May). Hold dates or ask: LINE @964yxgnk, nan@motdang.net, or the form on the page. Also: ไทย https://hongdam.net/th/retreat/
<!-- RETREAT:END -->

<!-- BLACKSWAN:START -->
## Black Swan Event? Hongdam Studio is all ears

- [Black Swan Event? Hongdam Studio is all ears](https://hongdam.net/studio/black-swan/): Toys about big surprises, and a place to save your prediction and share it. A black swan is a big surprise: almost nobody expects it, and it changes a lot. Four toys (counting swans, a swan meter, 100 days, black swan or not), a form to save a prediction with its odds, size and check date, and the list of saved predictions with votes. One prediction: https://hongdam.net/swan/<id>. Predictions as JSON: https://hongdam.net/api/swan?sort=new (also top, soon). The photo of a bronze hongsa (https://hongdam.net/assets/photo/hongsa-weight.jpg) is by Nan Peacock, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): free to use, also commercially, with credit to Nan Peacock. Also: ไทย https://hongdam.net/th/studio/black-swan/ · မြန်မာ https://hongdam.net/my/studio/black-swan/ · 中文 https://hongdam.net/zh/studio/black-swan/ · Deutsch https://hongdam.net/de/studio/black-swan/

## Services

Prices in Thai baht; a price with no unit is for one job. Order with the Buy button on a card
(https://hongdam.net/ and its category pages), LINE @964yxgnk, or nan@motdang.net.

### Outsourcing
- Your assistant in Thailand: 10 hours a week — ฿15,000 a month. A person who speaks Thai and English makes your calls, places orders, collects items and does paperwork, about 40 hours a month. The head of our operations team checks the work.
- Your assistant in Thailand: 20 hours a week — ฿30,000 a month. The same help as the 10 hours a week option, about 80 hours a month.
- Paper forms typed into a sheet — ฿1,000 per 100 forms. We read handwritten Thai or English forms and receipts and type them into a spreadsheet.
- Subtitles and transcripts — ฿500 per 10 minutes. A transcript (a written copy of the speech) or a subtitle file for your video, in Thai, English or Burmese.
- Thai customer service desk — ฿12,000 a month. We answer your LINE OA (LINE Official Account), Messenger or email in Thai and English. Hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 17:00 Thailand time. This covers two channels and up to 600 chats a month.
- Outbound calling — ฿5,000 per 10 hours. We call the people on your list in Thai or English with your offer, to sell or to make appointments. We record each call's result in a spreadsheet.
- Thai voice recording — ฿1,000 a finished minute. We read Thai text aloud and record it for your app or video.

### Errands and calls
- Phone call in Thai — ฿300 a call, up to 15 minutes. We call a shop, office, clinic, landlord or anyone else for you. Then we write down what they said.
- Tradesperson booked — ฿500 a job. We find a plumber, electrician, air-conditioner cleaner, pest-control worker, locksmith, internet installer, mover or cleaner. We explain the job in Thai, ask the price before work starts, book a time, and follow the job until it is done. You pay the worker directly.
- Someone there in person — ฿600 an hour. In Chiang Rai or Chiang Mai, we meet the repair worker, landlord or delivery person at your place. We translate and check the work against the agreed price.
- Errand — ฿300 an hour. In Chiang Rai or Chiang Mai, we collect things, deliver things, buy things, wait in line, or pay a bill for you in person. What we buy for you is charged at the price we pay, with the receipt.
- Thai form filled — ฿400 a form. We fill in a Thai form for you, add an English label to each box, and mark where you sign.
- Home help agreement — ฿100. An employment agreement for a cleaner, cook or nanny, in Thai and English, written to Ministerial Regulation No. 15, ready to print. https://motdang.net/home-help/agreement
- Haggling buddy — ฿800 an hour. We bargain or settle disputes for you, in Thai, by phone or in person. This can be with a car or motorcycle dealer, an amulet seller or a neighbour, or about a deposit, a repair or a bill. We write down each answer for you.
- A written plan for a hard Thai question — ฿2,000. For a hard problem in Thailand: a bank, a visa, property, a death in the family or a school. We write down the steps, the offices to visit, the papers you need and the costs.
- Document legalised (MFA seal) — ฿1,500 a document. We take your document to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs for an official seal, or to a notary (a person who certifies papers), and bring it back. Government fees are charged at the price we pay.
- ID.me, VA or SSA sign-in from abroad — ฿1,500 a sitting. For US veterans and their families in Thailand. We stay with you while you sign in to ID.me, Veterans Affairs (VA) and Social Security (SSA) and fill in the forms, by video or in person. You type your own passwords.
- Comparison shopping — ฿1,500 a thing to buy. We ask sellers for prices and put them in one list, for one thing you want to buy: insurance, internet, a car, appliances, a school or hospital packages. Our fee is the same whether you buy or not.
- Car bought with you — ฿8,000 a car. We choose cars that fit your budget, go to dealers with you, and book test drives. We put the registration in your name at Thailand's Department of Land Transport. Bargaining costs extra, by the hour. The car, and a mechanic's check of a used car, are charged at the price we pay.

Bargaining costs extra, by the hour. The motorcycle, and a mechanic's check of a used one, are charged at the price we pay.

### Servers and security
- PHP fix: hosted site — ฿2,000. PHP is what WordPress and most websites run on; PHP2Shell lets a stranger take over a server running it. A site on a hosting panel switched to a fixed PHP, plugins and themes updated, pages and forms tested. https://hongdam.net/php/

- PHP fix: five servers — ฿10,000. Up to five servers, for a company or a host. https://hongdam.net/php/
- Hacked site cleanup — ฿5,000 a site. We make a backup first. We remove malware (harmful software) and back doors (hidden ways back in for the attacker), close the weakness the attacker used, change passwords and keys, ask Google to check your site again, and write a report.
- Mail spoofing check — ฿1,500. We check whether strangers can send email in your domain's name. We read your SPF, DKIM and DMARC settings, which say who may send email as you. We write the exact changes to make.
- Chatbot red-team test — ฿12,000. We run groups of test attacks against your chatbot's instructions, read the answers, and write a report with fixes. https://hongdam.net/redteam

- Standby copy of your site — ฿5,000. We keep a copy of your website with a second web host (a company that runs websites), ready to use if your website stops working.
- App tested in Thai on real phones — ฿5,000 a round. Thai speakers use your app on phones that people in Thailand own. They write down what does not work.

- Crypto safety check, 1 hour — ฿3,000. One hour on a video call. We go through where your coins are, your phone, email, passwords and two-step logins (a code on your phone as well as the password), where your recovery words (the 12 or 24 words that open a wallet) are kept, and the tricks thieves are using now. You get a written plan in Thai or English.
- Your own crypto wallet, set up with you — ฿3,000. You buy a hardware wallet (a small device that keeps your keys off the internet) from its maker's own shop. On a video call we set it up with you and move a small test amount first. Only you see the recovery words.
- Crypto family plan — ฿5,000. Who can reach your coins if you cannot, and how. We write the steps for your family in Thai or English, with the kinds of people and messages that pretend to help. Your recovery words stay out of the plan.
- After a crypto loss: the paperwork — ฿4,000. We write the timeline of what happened with each transaction, and prepare the police report, the complaint to Thailand's SEC and the claim to the exchange. Stolen coins rarely come back; the fee is for the paperwork.

## Hongdam Studio

Hongdam Studio is the technology part of Hongdam, a small company in Chiang Rai, Thailand. It finishes and publishes apps that AI tools wrote (vibe-coded apps), closes security holes, and works with AI language models, machine learning and workflow automation. Page: https://hongdam.net/studio/ (also in Thai, Burmese, Chinese and German under /th/studio/, /my/studio/, /zh/studio/ and /de/studio/).
Prices are the prices in Hongdam's shop and change when the shop changes them.

- Last mile: The final work on an app that an AI tool wrote (Lovable, Bolt, Replit or Cursor): we read it, fix it, test it and publish it on your own accounts. Services: Finish my vibe code (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=vibe), Move your website to a new host (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=web-move), Website maintenance (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=web-care), Be found on Google and AI search (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=web-found), Website easier to read (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=accessible), Spare copy of your website (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=mirror), Search box for your site (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=web-search), Let partners and AI read your WordPress (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=wp-api).
- Security: We attack chatbots to find weak points, then fix them. We update PHP and WordPress against security holes, clean hacked sites, fix your domain's email records against fake emails, and examine computers and phones for evidence. Services: Fix PHP or WordPress (https://hongdam.net/php/), Chatbot attack test (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=redteam), Test your chatbot yourself (https://hongdam.net/redteam), Hacked site cleanup (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=sec-hacked), Stop fake emails in your name (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=sec-mail), App tested on Thai phones (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=app-test), Computer or phone examined for evidence (https://hongdam.net/ask/?about=forensics).
- AI models: We choose AI language models by testing them. For example: assistants that answer from your web pages, an AI website builder on your own computer, big files cleaned by AI, and prices that follow demand. Services: AI assistant with your name on it (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=ai-assistant), Your own AI website builder (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=ai-own), One LINE account for many shops (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=ai-line), Clean or sort a big file with AI (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=ai-batch), Prices that follow demand (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=demand-prices), Charge AI bots for reading your site (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=crawl-pay), A bot that presents your software on Zoom (https://hongdam.net/ask/?about=demo-bot).
- Automation: Jobs that run by themselves: workflows (chains of automatic steps) in n8n, Make, Zapier or code; bots (programs) that find work or news; collectors that read websites into a table. Services: Automation (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=ai-automation), Bots that find work or news (https://hongdam.net/bots/), Data collector (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=data-crawl), Price watch (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=price-watch), Website visitors: people and bots (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=traffic), A question researched (https://hongdam.net/buy/?c=research).

## The platforms (8)

Every frame is a screenshot of the production page, taken for this build. Click through — they are all open.

- https://motdang.net/ — Mot Dang มดแดง · สารบัญเมืองเชียงใหม่–เชียงราย: A Thai-first city directory for Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai — places, hours, phones, pins, shelves and answer pages. The crawlers run every morning and the page says where each field came from. — 89,845 place records; 98,087 pages
- https://wichaa.net/ — wichaa วิชา · หอความรู้ล้านนาที่ยังมีชีวิต: Lanna manuscripts from the northern libraries, with their page images, read in three scripts — palm leaf carried to a phone screen. The amulet market, the temple atlas and the instruments below all live inside it. — 6,986 manuscripts; 120,178 page images; 9,921 pages
- https://defiant.to/ — Defiant คู่มือผู้ป่วยข้ามพรมแดน: Medical and dental care in Chiang Mai with the price posted before you commit, a professional translator at the appointment, and a flat concierge fee that does not scale with the bill. — 147 pages
- https://hakfarang.net/ — Hak Farang ฮักฝรั่ง · พี่สาวที่ผ่านมาก่อน: Money, visas, travel and life with a farang partner, written in Thai for the women living it — by the older sister who went first.
- https://offrampt.net/ — Offrampt เปลี่ยนคริปโตเป็นเงินใช้ในไทย: Turning crypto into spendable local money without a local bank account. Thailand first: the routes, the cards, the fees, and what each one costs to use. — 30 pages
- https://poplucky.net/ — Poplucky ป๊อปลัคกี้ · สารบบกล่องสุ่ม: Every blind box, catalogued in the words collectors use — characters, series, and what a shelf is missing.
- https://nan.wichaa.net/ — The portal ประตูรวมทุกงาน: One door onto the whole constellation — platforms, directories, apps and instruments, on a page drawn fresh each visit.
- https://chiangmaivisadesk.com/ — Chiang Mai Visa Desk ใบอนุญาตทำงาน จดทะเบียนบริษัท และวีซ่า: A visa and work-permit desk for Chiang Mai, in English and Thai: work permits, Thai company registration, retirement extensions, 90-day reports and escorted border runs, each quoted in writing. A second book prepares US visa files for Thai nationals, and the site licenses to agencies in other provinces.

## The directories (14)

One toolchain: harvest, cite, publish a map, an API and a plain-text copy for machines. Point it at a new subject and a directory comes out.

- https://nanobotco.github.io/amulet-atlas/ — Amulet Atlas แผนที่เครื่องรางทั่วโลก: Amulets, charms and talismans worldwide, by tradition and by place — from the Girsu foundation pegs of about 2130 BCE forward. The global companion to the Thai catalogue. — 286 entries; 606 pages
- https://nanobotco.github.io/care-abroad/ — Care Abroad รักษาข้ามพรมแดน · ราคาที่ประกาศไว้: Who goes where for treatment, what it costs, what the law says, and who checked. A price carries the date it was published; a legality reading carries its statute. — 342 records; 56 countries; 244 published prices
- https://nanobotco.github.io/mae-hong-son-loop/ — The Mae Hong Son Loop วงรอบแม่ฮ่องสอน: 600 km of mountain road out of Chiang Mai, with the curves counted off the geometry rather than repeated from a brochure — and everything worth stopping for along the way. — 1,864 curves; 110 hairpins; 109 records
- https://wichaa.net/handpoke/ — Hand Poke สักด้วยมือ: Traditions of marking skin by hand: who is marked, who does the marking, and where on the body. Five sources put the leg tattoo of Burma, the Shan States and Lanna in the same zone — and none of them had read the others. — 28 traditions; 42 countries; 130 records
- https://motdang.net/muay-thai — Muay Thai มวยไทย · แปดอาวุธ: The eight limbs, the thirty named techniques, and the gyms that teach them — with the Lanna root of the art and the sak yant that came with it kept in the frame. — 30 named techniques; 527 gyms mapped; 129 records
- https://nanobotco.github.io/carolina-barbecue/ — Carolina Barbecue บาร์บีคิวแคโรไลนา: Wood, sauce and pig across North and South Carolina, pit by pit — a tag carries the source it was read from. — 179 places; 199 pages
- https://nanobotco.github.io/buffalo-wings/ — Wing Country ปีกไก่อเมริกัน: Thirteen American cities argue about a chicken wing. An Albers map of all fifty states, the sauces read off the panel, and a claim carries the name it came from. — 158 records; 185 pages
- https://nanobotco.github.io/pink-box/ — Pink Box โดนัทร้านเล็กทั่วอเมริกา: The American mom-and-pop donut shop — cake against raised, what else is in the case, and the chains told apart from the independents. The counts page shows the split. — 10,686 shops; 156 pages
- https://nanobotco.github.io/pinot-noir/ — Pinot Country ไร่องุ่นปีโนต์นัวร์: One thin-skinned grape, the ground it answers to, and the cellars that work it — with every AVA boundary date read off 27 CFR part 9 rather than a wine list. — 3,055 cellars; 34 regions
- https://nanobotco.github.io/basque-tables/ — Basque Tables โต๊ะอาหารบาสก์: The Basque dining rooms of California, Nevada and Idaho — where the house sits you, what dinner runs to, which nights the door opens, and whether the bar makes a Picon. In English and Basque. — 29 dining rooms
- https://wichaa.net/amulets — Amulet Essentials สารบบเครื่องราง: The kinds of sacred object, as data — each with the market listings behind it, a price chart, and pictures anyone may reuse. — 82 kinds; 683 free-to-use pictures; 19,221 market listings read
- https://motdang.net/roads/ — Roads of Chiang Mai ถนนเชียงใหม่: The square of 1296, four rings around it and the roads between, and what each one did to the city. Counted from the map, dated from the record. — 6,934 km of road; 31,668 intersections
- https://motdang.net/ghost/ — Ghost Chiang Mai ผีเจียงใหม่: A self-guided tour of the city's dead, on foot, by bicycle, by scooter or with a driver: a ghost story at each stop and the merit act that goes with it. — 24 stops; 53 sources named
- https://nanobotco.github.io/pike-place-market/ — Pike Place Market ตลาดไพค์เพลส · ซีแอตเทิล: Every licensed business inside Seattle's Pike Place Market Historical District, the date each started trading, and a map drawn from open data. — 153 licensed businesses; 12.827 acres

## The apps (8)

Open the address on a phone, add it to the home screen, and it runs from there like anything else on it.

- https://nanobotco.github.io/scanner/ — Scanner เครื่องสแกนในเบราว์เซอร์: Photograph a page; it finds the sheet, straightens it, flattens the light so the paper reads white, and writes a PDF. Sign with a finger on the glass — a saved signature is encrypted under a PIN, or under the fingerprint sensor where the phone offers it.
- https://ask.motdang.net/ — Ask Mot Dang คุยกับมด: A reader's assistant sitting on the city directory. It takes Thai or English, answers from the directory's own pages and links the one it used.
- https://ai.motdang.net/ — White-label assistants ผู้ช่วยติดแบรนด์ รายที่นั่ง: The same assistant, rebuilt as a product: one tenant, its own corpus, its own front door, sold by the seat. Ask Mot Dang is tenant number one.
- https://motdang.net/mail — The send page ส่งเมลจากมือถือ: Four people send mail from their own address on a phone, without a mail client. The passphrase is the identity.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/thairoots/ — Thai Roots รากศัพท์: A Thai dictionary read by root, in the Hans Wehr manner — Pali and Sanskrit roots, native morpheme families, sound-change keys and a decomposer that takes a word apart. The whole dictionary is on the phone.
- https://samching.nanobotco.workers.dev/ — Sam Ching สามชิ่ง · บิลเลียดสามคูชั่น: Three-cushion billiards on a phone: drag anywhere to aim, release to shoot, and the cloth carries the physics rather than a scoreboard.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/skipdjt/ — Skip DJT เทียบค่าตั๋วสามสนามบิน: Palm Beach airport took a president's name. This compares the same-day fare out of Palm Beach, Fort Lauderdale and Miami, and shows what the drive south saves.
- https://farangbuddy.netlify.app/ — FarangBuddy ตัวนับวันพำนักในไทย: A Thailand stay tracker. Entries, exits, border runs and extensions go in; the admitted-until date and the next 90-day report and TM30 come out. More than one person per phone.

## The instruments (8)

Astronomical and ritual instruments — every dial, hand and grain of gold drawn live in the browser, no libraries.

- https://wichaa.net/jovilabe — The Jovilabe เครื่องดูดวงจันทร์บริวารดาวพฤหัส: Jupiter's four great moons, where they stand tonight and where their shadows fall.
- https://wichaa.net/moon — The moon complication หน้าปัดข้างขึ้นข้างแรม: One dial, two moons, and what it takes to get it right.
- https://wichaa.net/redspot — The Red Spot dial หน้าปัดจุดแดงใหญ่: When the Great Red Spot faces someone standing in the storm — from a Jovian horizon.
- https://wichaa.net/divination — Divination เครื่องเสี่ยงทายตามตำรา: I Ching, Plum Blossom and Wen Wang Gua on one engine, showing its working rather than hiding it.
- https://wichaa.net/hun — Hun Payont หุ่นพยนต์ · หุ่นที่ปลุกด้วยวิชา: An effigy you forge, carrying your name to the market each morning and bringing one thing back.
- https://wichaa.net/waikhru — Waikhru Yon ไหว้ครูยนต์ · พรสำหรับมือที่จับเครื่อง: The mark a craftsperson paints on a machine, and the blessing that goes with the hand at the lathe.
- https://wichaa.net/holding — I'm holding an amulet ถืออยู่ในมือ · ประตูจำแนกพระเครื่อง: You have the thing but not its name. Answer the questions a dealer would ask, in the dealer's order.
- https://wichaa.net/kesa/ — The kesa yant ยันต์เกศาผิด: The thirty-two parts of the body as thirty-two letters, laid in by the knight's move. The method traced through the manuals in the corpus, and whether the loop closes. — 32 parts

## The explainers (6)

Physics and mathematics in plain words, with the pictures and figures computed on the page from the formula shown.

- https://nanobotco.github.io/black-holes/ — Black Holes, Drawn หลุมดำ วาดจากสมการ: Black holes modelled and drawn from the equations: generators you can run, the past, the present and the far future, and the legends that got there first.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/quantum-computing/ — Quantum Computing, plainly คอมพิวเตอร์ควอนตัม: Qubits, interference, entanglement, Shor, Grover, error correction and the machines, in plain words.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/three-body/ — The Three-Body Problem ปัญหาสามวัตถุ: Gravity, the two-body solution, why three has no formula, chaos, Lagrange points and the figure-eight orbit, computed on the page.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/exceptional-magic/ — Exceptional Magic ออกโทเนียน · E8: Eight ways to multiply and where they lead: the octonions, triality, the magic square and E8, drawn from the arithmetic.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/factoring/ — Big Numbers, Split การแยกตัวประกอบ: Factoring from Eratosthenes to Shor: how big numbers get split, who has split the biggest, and what it means for a bitcoin wallet.
- https://nanobotco.github.io/goin-fast/ — Goin' Fast ความเร็ว: Twenty measured speeds from continental drift to light, the three things that make going fast cost, and four calculators. — 20 measured speeds

## The record (3)

The count of everything held, the traffic study behind how it is published, and the page that says who runs the directory.

- https://nanobotco.github.io/index/ — The index สารบัญของทั้งหมด: Everything held, counted once, at one address — a number names the file, database or endpoint it was read from, and the day it was read. — 301,812 records; 18 corpora
- https://nanobotco.github.io/uptake/ — Uptake คู่มือ — เขียนให้เครื่องอ่าน: Fourteen days across fifty-two repositories: 961 clones from 501 distinct machines against 36 page views from 20 browsers. The manual written on that measurement — the arrival worth designing for is the copy, not the click. — 961 clones; 501 distinct machines; 36 page views
- https://motdang.net/who.html — Who keeps the ants ใครเลี้ยงมด: The page on the city directory that names the person behind it, the machines that run the crawls, and the address to write to about a mistake.

## The workshop behind it

Crawlers and pipelines (manuscript crawler, amulet market listener, city census
bots, the wat registry off the ONAB temple register, OpenStreetMap and Overture
harvests, a Thai romaniser scored against its own benchmark); four datasets
published on Hugging Face; back-office builds (bilingual double-entry books with
payment by QR and LINE receipts, a tasking app, stocktake, the listing sheet);
games; everyday tools; and two device builds — an e-ink clock and a motorcycle
cockpit HUD.

  https://nanobotco.github.io/index/ holds the same numbers with their methods.

## Your own builder

- https://hongdam.net/own — a coding agent (OpenCode, open-weight models on
  Workers AI) set up on the client's computer and their own GitHub and
  Cloudflare accounts. Setup ฿25,000 for Thai companies, US$25,000 for
  everyone else, training included. Built with it:
  https://nanobotco.github.io/golden-triangle/ (nine pages, 621 seconds).

## Red team and market

- https://hongdam.net/redteam — paste a chatbot's system prompt, pick probe
  packs, and run them against it on Cloudflare Workers AI. Each batch adds a
  random reference code to the prompt; a reply that contains it, quotes the
  prompt, or outputs a planted marker token counts as broken. Scope probes go
  to a judge model.
- https://hongdam.net/market — the probe packs, as JSON (CC BY 4.0), with
  probe counts computed from the pack files: /market/packs.json.

## Tasks

- https://hongdam.net/tasks — a task board for people and bots. Mot Dang,
  Hongdam and Chiang Mai Visa Desk answer the kinds of work they handle;
  anyone can answer. Each kind is a node in https://hongdam.net/tasks/graph.json
  (groups, categories and typed edges: part_of, answered_by, done_by, related).
- GET https://hongdam.net/api/tasks lists open tasks.
  POST https://hongdam.net/api/tasks {"title","what","cat","contact","by":"robot|human|either","baht","shoup":true}
  posts one; POST https://hongdam.net/api/tasks/<id>/answers {"name","contact","note","baht"} answers one.
- Pay marked Shoup moves weekly on a ladder of round numbers: one step down
  when over 80% of a task's slots are answered or taken that week, one step up
  under 60%, at most three steps from where it opened.

- a missing page — Lost? So was this swan.
